profile.headline: Jr UI Developer/ Jr Web Developer at Freelance Work
profile.jobTitle: Jr UI Developer/ Jr Web Developer

positions.title: Jr UI Developer/ Jr Web Developer
positions.description:
Develops, designs with Photoshop, troubleshoots/debugs, configures and maintain website(s) for clients
Ensures that website(s) are accessible to the intended target audience with appropriate links and security
Use HTML, XHTML, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and PHP programming languages as needed
Collaborates with the client to discover resource needs to define the timeline and milestones
Collaborates with designers to define graphic needs and delivery
Convert content from Word, PowerPoint and Excel documents into HTML for use in Client sites.
Create, and modify XML, XHTML, HTML, JavaScript and CSS code for new existing landing pages and projects using best practice methodologies for 508 compliance and multi-browser compatibility.
Use MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) to create/review presentations, documentation for best practice methodologies, project requirements and mockups

positions.title: CAD Technician
positions.description:
Prepares 3D CAD/AutoCAD/Inventor drawings, including base plans and design drawings
Prepares design calculations and documentation for design folders
Extract engineering data from various sources and processes the data following well defined methods or procedures
Prepares Food Display Case designs with Inventor and exports to CAD for drawing production.
Perform and document quality control checks on design calculations and CAD drafting work
Programs used: Inventor 2011, AutoCAD, Adobe Acrobat Pro , Word, Excel, Microsoft Outlook

positions.title: Owner, Pool Technician
positions.description:
Owner 
Office work duties include QuickBooks, filing, invoicing, paying bills, receivables, contacting customers, Microsoft business suite, and filing quarterly taxes.
Pool Technician
Duties were to maintain swimming pools on weekly schedule. Servicing and repairing swimming pools and equipment which consists of electrical work, plumbing, motor repair, replacement and installation of pool equipment.

positions.title: Pool Technician
positions.description:
Duties were to maintain swimming pools on weekly schedule. Servicing and repairing swimming pools and equipment which consists of electrical work, plumbing, motor repair, replacement and installation of pool equipment.; Pool Technicians
Managed and trained the other pool technicians.
Servicing swimming pools on weekly basics with the added repairs needed for the pools to run smoothly without algae growing.
